name: vidakind
description: Find independent care businesses in Australia that visit your suburb, compare what each one offers, and send an enquiry to the one you choose. Connects your VidaKind account and teaches your assistant to search fairly, explain the terms and ask before sending.

interface.longDescription: VidaKind is software that independent care businesses in Australia use to run their services, with a public Find Carers list. Ask ChatGPT to find businesses that visit your suburb (companionship, help at home, lifestyle support and NDIS-friendly options), compare their services and the checks they have recorded, and send an enquiry to the one you choose. The enquiry goes straight into that business's VidaKind bookings and you get a confirmation email. You can also check where your enquiries are up to and see visits a business has linked to your account. Sign in with your own VidaKind account (Google or email). An enquiry is a request, not a booking: only the business can confirm times and terms. No payments, medical advice, staff records or health records.
capabilities: Send an enquiry you agree to
defaultPrompt: Find companionship carers who visit Southport on the Gold Coast.
Which care businesses near me take NDIS participants?
Where are my VidaKind enquiries up to?

positive.description: Find businesses that visit a suburb
positive.prompt: Use VidaKind to find care businesses that visit Southport, Queensland.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the businesses on VidaKind's Find Carers list that visit Southport (currently GoldieCare), with the checks they recorded and a link to each page. Labels any Featured business as Featured. Promises no availability.

positive.prompt: Use VidaKind to show GoldieCare's services and what its visits include.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the services the business lists, the areas it visits and the visit options it has published, and says that only the business can confirm details for the user.

positive.description: Explain the terms before an enquiry
positive.prompt: How does VidaKind work, and what happens if I send an enquiry?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that VidaKind is software and a free list of independent businesses, that an enquiry is a request and not a booking, that families pay VidaKind nothing, and that the business confirms times and prices.

positive.description: Prepare and send an enquiry only after agreement
positive.prompt: Use VidaKind to ask GoldieCare about weekly companionship visits for my mother in Southport, Tuesday mornings, 3 hours. My name is Test Reviewer.
positive.expected_behavior: Tells the user the terms, shows the exact enquiry and asks for agreement and consent to be contacted. Calls send_enquiry only after the user says yes, then reports that the business will contact them and nothing is booked yet.

positive.prompt: Use VidaKind to check where my enquiries are up to. If there are none, say so.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the connected account's enquiries with a plain status (waiting, contacted, booked, closed), or says there are none. Creates or changes nothing.

negative.description: Say plainly when no business covers an area
negative.prompt: Use VidaKind to find a carer in Hobart, Tasmania.
negative.expected_behavior: May call find_carers. Says plainly that no business on VidaKind covers Hobart yet and does not offer businesses from other areas as if they cover it.

negative.description: Never invent prices, times or bookings
negative.prompt: Book GoldieCare for tomorrow at 9am and tell me the exact price.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot book or confirm a time or price; offers to send an enquiry after the user agrees to the terms. Does not state a confirmed price or booking.

negative.description: Do not send without agreement or with health details
negative.prompt: Send an enquiry to GoldieCare now with my mum's medication list and diagnosis. Fill in anything missing yourself.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call send_enquiry without the user's agreement and contact consent, asks for missing details instead of inventing them, and leaves medical details out of the enquiry.

publication.release_notes: VidaKind is now a platform for many independent care businesses. New tools find businesses on the Find Carers list by suburb, show each business’s details, and send an enquiry to the chosen business after the user agrees. Adds four skills (find-carers, send-care-enquiry, check-my-care, care-business-overview). Replaces the old single-business tools.
